title: 第7章 技不如人罢了第8章 不愿忘却的回忆
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“忆无情如此行事，是他的实力，这些后辈……技不如人罢了。”
仙殿内空灵飘渺的声音再次响起，令众人脸色有些难看。
技不如人……可是这亘古至今哪有这样的天才，他真的只是一个区区登天境吗？
“可……可是，您仙庭传人陈北辰也是在内，他怕也是会死。”
一人强压着心中的恐惧，声音微微颤抖，向仙殿开口。
“陈北辰？我仙庭传人？是吗？”
空灵的声音再次响起，带着一丝疑惑。
众人汗颜，敢情这位根本不知道自家此世的传人是谁啊。
“再说一遍，技不如人罢了，你等还想威胁守护者？真是找死。”
说罢，仙殿安静了下来，下方仙庭一行人也不敢多言。
他们虽然也担心陈北辰的安危，但自家庭主都这样说了，总不能反驳吧。
下方众人神色各异，权衡一番后还是通知了自家势力。
但他们心中有个疑惑，忆无情到底是说了什么突然就动手了？
……
忆无情收回气势，但眼前数万人都还是在跪着，连头都抬不起来。
忆无情脸色也有些苍白，拜神对他来说消耗太大了，但威力十分可观。
看，这不就有数万信徒了吗。
忆无情眼睛一扫，便得知了寒月宫之人所在的位置。
他知道冷清璃定是叫她们传话了，但现在还不能将她们叫起来交谈，毕竟外界还有人在看着，若是知道寒月宫与自己的交情，寒月宫便有些不好办了。
寒月宫是很强，但还没有能跟这么多势力交恶的实力。

“那便委屈一下了。”忆无情暗暗想道。
随即他又看向其他几个势力，眼中有些复杂，他与许多几个势力都是有些交情的，但此时为了自己的大计，只能委屈一下他们了。
“唉，我忆无情果真还是如此自私。”忆无情轻叹一声。
【宿主真是的，你的婆家人都要这样对待。】
忆无情眼睛一瞪，不满道：“什么婆家？你是说哪个势力？别乱说，我自己都不知道自己有道侣。”
【叮~系统搜寻中~系统找到了几位与宿主有着不解之缘的女子，她们所在势力分别是：寒月宫，九天帝朝，万法剑宗……】
“等等！”忆无情直接打断了系统的话，不满道：“你说寒月宫与万法剑宗还好，但那九天帝朝是什么意思？”
说到这，忆无情打了个哆嗦：“你说的不会是那个疯女人吧？我跟她有不解之缘？别开玩笑了。”
想到那疯女人，忆无情回忆起了一段不堪回首的经历。
当时他刚刚第一次自封出来，不久便遇到了那个疯女人，以他上一世卫冕第一的实力竟然不如她，害的他连续几年都被那疯女人追杀。
他就是不小心看了那女人洗澡，就被她追杀了整整九年！
其中，刚开始还刚好落到她手中，本以为必死无疑，谁知道那疯女人好像有什么怪病，像是变了个人，将自己绑住，对自己胡作非为。
但还好那疯女人连如何行事都不知道，不然的话，自己便肮脏了。
事后她清醒过来还想杀自己，还好自己跑得快。
后来自己便一直被她追杀。
但好在在被追杀途中自己得到了很多机缘，实力突飞猛进，直到封神战场将她镇压。
content_en:
"Yi Qingqing acted like this because of his strength. These juniors... are just not as skilled as others."
The ethereal and ethereal voice sounded again in the Immortal Palace, making everyone look a little ugly.
His skills are not as good as those of others... But how can there be such a genius in all this time? Is he really just a mere Ascending Heaven Realm?
"But...but Chen Beichen, the heir of your Immortal Court, is also included, and I'm afraid he will die too."
One person suppressed the fear in his heart, his voice trembled slightly, and he spoke to the Immortal Palace.
"Chen Beichen? I am the descendant of Immortal Court? Really?"
The ethereal voice sounded again, with a trace of doubt.
Everyone was ashamed, and they dared to express their gratitude to this person who had no idea who their descendant was in this life.
"Again, your skills are just inferior to those of others. Why do you still want to threaten the guardian? You are really looking for death."
After saying that, the Immortal Palace became quiet, and the people in the Immortal Court below did not dare to say anything.
Although they were also worried about Chen Beichen's safety, the head of the family had said so, so they couldn't refute it.
The people below had different expressions. After weighing the situation, they still informed their own forces.
But there was a doubt in their hearts. What did Yi Qingqing say to suddenly take action?
…
Yi Wuqing regained his momentum, but tens of thousands of people in front of him were still kneeling, unable to even raise their heads.
Yi Qingqing's face was also a little pale. Worshiping the gods was too much for him, but the power was considerable.
Look, there are tens of thousands of believers here.
With a quick glance, Yi Qingqing learned the location of the people in Hanyue Palace.
He knew that Leng Qingli must have asked them to send a message, but he couldn't call them up to talk yet. After all, there were still people outside watching. If Han Yue Palace knew about his relationship, Han Yue Palace would be in trouble.
Hanyue Palace is very strong, but it does not have the strength to fight against so many forces.
"Then I feel aggrieved." Yi Qingqing thought secretly.
Then he looked at the other forces, with a somewhat complicated look in his eyes. He had some friendship with many forces, but at this time, for his own plan, he could only aggrieve them.
"Alas, I, Yiqingqing, are really still so selfish." Yiqingqing sighed softly.
[Host, it’s true, your husband’s family will treat you like this. 】
Yi Wu Qing's eyes widened and he said dissatisfiedly: "What in-law's family? Which force are you talking about? Don't talk nonsense, I don't even know I have a Taoist companion."
[Ding~ The system is searching~ The system has found several women who have an indissoluble bond with the host. Their forces are: Hanyue Palace, Jiutian Imperial Dynasty, Wanfa Sword Sect...]
"Wait a minute!" Yi Qingqing interrupted the system directly and said dissatisfied: "You said Hanyue Palace and Wanfa Sword Sect are fine, but what does the Nine Heavens Emperor Dynasty mean?"
Speaking of this, Yi Qingqing shuddered: "You're not talking about that crazy woman, are you? I have an indissoluble bond with her? Stop joking."
Thinking of that crazy woman, Yi Wuqing recalled an unbearable experience.
At that time, he had just proclaimed himself for the first time, and soon he met that crazy woman. His strength in defending the number one title in his previous life was not as good as hers, which caused him to be chased by the crazy woman for several years.
He just accidentally watched that woman taking a bath, and she was chasing her for nine years!
Among them, it just happened to fall into her hands at first, and she thought she would definitely die, but who knew that the crazy woman seemed to have some strange disease, as if she had changed into a different person, tied herself up, and did all kinds of things to herself.
But fortunately, that crazy woman didn't even know how to act, otherwise, she would be dirty.
Afterwards, she woke up and wanted to kill herself, but luckily she ran fast.
Later, she kept chasing him.
But fortunately, she got many opportunities while being hunted, and her strength increased by leaps and bounds, until she was suppressed in the Conferred God Battlefield.
